hypothesis: A single daily-data variance-risk-premium proxy can identify underinvested frozen V11 trade events where using half of the unused risk budget improves net CAGR by at least 0.50 percentage points while matching or exceeding V11 Sharpe, beating an availability-matched unconditional completion control, and preserving <=10% full-history MDD.
allowed_changes: F-VRP-PROXY exact VIXCLS-squared minus 21-session annualized daily realized-variance proxy
trailing threshold fixed to the median of the previous 252 valid VRP proxy market-session observations excluding the current observation
at eligible underinvested frozen V11 trade events, fill exactly 50% of unused gross pro rata across current positive V11 holdings when the frozen proxy state is risk-on
selection_metric: No within-family model selection. There is exactly one candidate; report it against frozen V11 and C-VRP-ALWAYS and apply all preregistered deterministic, bootstrap and cumulative DSR gates.
pass_fail_gates: deterministic: full CAGR >= V11 CAGR +0.50 percentage points
deterministic: at least 5/7 fixed folds candidate Sharpe >= matched-control Sharpe
deterministic: gross <=100%, min target weight >=0, no financing or negative cash
bootstrap: paired circular moving blocks, 63 sessions, 20000 replicates, seed 20260821
PBO: not applicable because the family contains exactly one preregistered candidate and no within-family selection
global post-protocol DSR probability >=95% using the prior 24 formal return-seeking candidates plus F-VRP-PROXY, total trial count 25
ROBUST_FACTOR_PASS requires every applicable deterministic, bootstrap and global DSR gate
follow_up_policy: This campaign contains exactly one candidate. After any formal result is viewed, do not search alternate realized-volatility windows, thresholds, percentiles, VIX/VIX3M substitutions, completion fractions, event definitions, candidate replacements, or a second retrospective VRP-proxy family. A promising non-robust proxy may only enter a new prospective trial from a new freeze date. A future canonical VRP study using model-free option-implied variance and intraday realized variation is a materially new dataset/methodology and requires a new preregistration.
swift_engine_entrypoint: scripts/run_vrp_proxy_v1.py -> tools/vrp_proxy_v1.swiftpart + tools/vrp_proxy_v1_logic.swift -> frozen V11 source run + BacktestEngine.runResearchTargetProviderStrategyWithTrace -> shared BacktestDailySimulator
expected_outputs: V11-CONTROL metrics and frozen target fingerprint
all seven fixed fold metrics plus 2020+ and 2022+ slices
source/eligible/available/completed event counts and portfolio constraints
run authorization receipt, execution Git commit and SHA-256 result artifact manifest

factor_definition.disclosure: This trial is a daily-data proxy and must not be represented as the canonical model-free variance risk premium. The proxy uses VIXCLS squared minus 21-session realized variance from frozen daily S&P 500 sleeve prices.
factor_definition.vix_availability_rule: latest finite VIX close with observation_date <= frozen V11 signal_date and <=7 calendar days stale
factor_definition.realized_variance_rule: RV21_t=(252/21)*sum(log(P_i/P_{i-1})^2) across the 21 returns ending at market session t
factor_definition.threshold_rule: median of exactly the previous 252 valid market-session VRP proxy observations, excluding t

matched_control.rule: Whenever F-VRP-PROXY is available at an eligible underinvested frozen V11 event, fill exactly 50% of unused gross regardless of factor state

shared_rules.event_scope: unique execution dates on which frozen V11 report.trades is non-empty
shared_rules.eligibility: current frozen V11 positive gross strictly between 0 and 1 and VRP proxy available

forbidden_changes: any frozen V11 parameter or target-path rule change
any alternative realized-volatility window including 10, 20, 30, 42, 63 or 252 sessions
any alternative VRP threshold, mean, z-score, percentile, persistence or threshold tuning
any VIX3M substitution, VIX/VIX3M ensemble, source substitution or revised source after results
factor-driven trades between frozen V11 event dates
candidate replacement or a second retrospective candidate after results
changing fee/slippage, leverage, financing, shorting or cash constraints
dropping failed prior formal candidates from cumulative DSR accounting
describing this daily-data proxy as the canonical model-free variance risk premium
